t_advice_summary_textbox.text: For the 1st part it seemed like picking the specific colours was the best way to go about it and that the correct "colour" could possibly change every couple rounds, however, I found that going by the colour of the basket was the better. In my opinion I feel that going with the yellow basket was the best case, but sometimes picking the red basket was the better choice. Regardless this is meant to be a fun game, so don't stress yourself over it! :)

vb_textbox.text: At first I was just randomly picking, trying to pick up any pattern at all. I noticed certain colours seemed to give me more than others - red seemed to be better than yellow, blue better than brown, so I usually went for this colour. As the game went on I tried to go for the more red-ish colours as I found they payed more points - apart from the blue vs brown gnomes as I still went for blue. I also tried different strategies like just picking gnomes on one side or choosing a different colour each time, which gave me varied results. In the end I went back to choosing the more red-ish colours and picked blue over brown. I hope this advice can be useful, and remember this is just a game, so don't stress yourself and try to have fun! :)
